story.title: Bella the young scientist
paragraphs_en: It was a fine, cool evening. The sun was setting with its faint ,soft light growing dimmer and dimmer. Bella Chapman, a seven year old girl, was walking home with her squirrel, Nibbles. Bella lives in Kyoto, Japan.Her village never had newspapers to get them updated. She always esteems nature. She is from a indigent family, but reads and writes very well. She loves science as much as she likes herself. She enjoys going to school. Her father, Oliver worked in a Lead Smelting factory, the factory he worked was polluted with harmful gases which caused his death.

From that day on-wards she stopped her schooling to help her mother and to save money for her little sister, Katie. She assured to learn and explore things to teach Katie. Katie was a 3 year old child, yet to join school. Their mother,Chloe, was an illiterate.

Mrs. Chloe soon started a milk business. She traded milk, cream, butter,cheese and many more milk products to make money for her family. The business was a great success. Their family, Mrs.Chloe, Bella, Katie, Nibbles soon had enough food to eat. 3 years passed Katie went to the same school as Bella. Bella promised her mother to make Katie study well and complete her school. Bella soon started her inventions and explorations.

She wanted to make her family's survival easier, So she worked day and night and found something troublesome, she did not have enough light to work with. So she took a bulb for working, then she found out it wouldn't work without electricity. Later on her friend from the other part of town told her that there was an electricity providing piece called a battery was being sold in markets, then she bought a battery and a wire and connected it to the bulb. It finally worked. She then took a piece of chart and encased it around the battery and bulb, for making it easy to hold. Soon all the villagers were amazed by her intelligence and bought some of her light producing bars, they were called as LPD's in her village. She made more money. Her mother was stunned by her intelligence and exalted her to the moon and back. With the money they produced they made their living more convinient.

One day, while she was doing her explorations she saw the river hastening towards the ocean, she tasted the water and found it to be salty. She then got an idea, she made a motor which converted salt water into a substance which can make things move faster, she connected it to a cycle and it was successful. the villagers even bought this for their well being. 5 years passed, Bella's family became richer day by day, they renovated their house. One day while her mother was returning form the market a drunkard had driven his vehicle on her leg and made her seriously ill. She had a fracture in her leg and couldn't walk. The doctor said that Chloe won't be able walk for 3 months, she will have to sit or sleep for the rest of the 3 months.

Bella felt sad for her mother. One day Chloe mourned to Bella that " Bella, only one week has gone so far, I feel so lonely being in this same room for almost all day, no one to talk with, I am sure this will drive me crazy one day". Bella was in tears hearing her mother say this. She sat in a corner and started thinking. She got an idea 'If wheels can move cycles and vehicles, why can't it move chairs'. She sprinted to the hardware store and bought 2 wheels. Bella and her sister fixed the wheels on to the chair. They made Chloe sit on it and they took her out. this made Chloe feel so happy and proud of her daughters. The villagers honored their family. Years passed, Bella got older and was married. she had twins - Bonnie, Bill. She started a business with Katie,which defined products according to people's needs. Later on she was the most respected and the richest family in their village
MORAL: HARD-WORK AND PERSEVERANCE ALWAYS PAYS OFF
